# Support Polarity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SupportPolarity`](gmeow-SupportPolarity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SupportPolarity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The closed three-value polarity of an evidence span toward its claim.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SupportPolarity`](gmeow-SupportPolarity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the closed three-value vocabulary (supports / refutes / neutral) that [`gmeow:supportPolarity`](../properties/gmeow-supportPolarity.md) draws from for a span's stance toward its claim.

### Avoid when

- Avoid extending it with new individuals (the three values are closed, unlike the open kind vocabularies) and avoid using it for inter-work citation stance (that is [`gmeow:citationIntent`](../properties/gmeow-citationIntent.md)).

### How to use

- Reference one of the three seeded individuals ([`gmeow:polaritySupports`](../individuals/gmeow-polaritySupports.md) / [`gmeow:polarityRefutes`](../individuals/gmeow-polarityRefutes.md) / [`gmeow:polarityNeutral`](../individuals/gmeow-polarityNeutral.md)) from a span via [`gmeow:supportPolarity`](../properties/gmeow-supportPolarity.md).

### Examples

- ex:polarityRefutes a [`gmeow:SupportPolarity`](gmeow-SupportPolarity.md).
